lineID = self.view.params.lineID
	
	checkRunningFlows = '''select top(1) * from SPFlowLogging where lineID = ? order by startdate desc'''
	checkRunningFlowsArgs = [lineID]
	
	checkRunningFlow = system.db.runPrepQuery(checkRunningFlows, checkRunningFlowsArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	if checkRunningFlow.getRowCount() == 0:
		return
	if checkRunningFlow.getValueAt(0, 'EndDate') is not None:
		return
	
	else:
		articleID = checkRunningFlow.getValueAt(0, 'ArticleID')
		lineID = checkRunningFlow.getValueAt(0, 'LineID')
		flowID = checkRunningFlow.getValueAt(0, 'FlowID')
		procedureID = checkRunningFlow.getValueAt(0, 'ProcedureID')
		
		params = {'ArticleID': articleID,
				'LineID': lineID,
				'flowID': flowID,
				'procedureID': procedureID}
		
		system.perspective.navigate(view='ControlRoom/StartupProcedure/Procedures', params = params)

config.script:
lineID = self.getSibling("EmbeddedView").props.params.value
	articleID = self.getSibling("EmbeddedView_0").props.params.value
	
	getProcedureQuery = '''select 
								ProcedureID
							from
								SPProcedures
							where
								LineID = ?
								and
								ArticleID = ?
								and
								Active = 1'''
	getProcedureArgs = [lineID, articleID]
	procedureID = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(getProcedureQuery, getProcedureArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	mainSteps = system.db.runNamedQuery('Control_Room', 'StartupProcedures/getMainSteps', parameters = {'ProcedureID': procedureID})
	
	insertFlowQuery = '''insert into 
							SPFlowLogging
							(LineID,
							ArticleID,
							ProcedureID,
							StartDate)
						values
							(?,
							?,
							?,
							?)'''
	insertArgs = [lineID, articleID, procedureID, system.date.now()]
	flowID = system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertFlowQuery, insertArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD', getKey = 1)
	
	for row in range(mainSteps.getRowCount()):
		stepID = mainSteps.getValueAt(row, 'StepID')
		defaultStatus = 1
		insertQuery = '''insert into
							SPStepLogging
							(FlowID,
							StepID,
							Status)
						values
							(?,
							?,
							?)'''
		insertArgs = [flowID, stepID, defaultStatus]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertQuery, insertArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
		
		getSubSteps = '''select 
							subStepID
						from
							SPSubStepsConfig
						where 
							MainStepID = ?
							and
							Active = 1'''
		getSubStepArgs = [stepID]
		subSteps = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSubSteps, getSubStepArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
		
		for subStepRow in range(subSteps.getRowCount()):
			subStepID = subSteps.getValueAt(subStepRow, 'SubStepID')
			insertSubStepsQuery = '''insert into 
									SPSubStepLogging
									(FlowID,
									SubStepID)
								values
									(?,
									?)'''
			args = [flowID, subStepID]
			system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertSubStepsQuery, args, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	system.perspective.navigate(view='ControlRoom/StartupProcedure/Procedures', params = {'ArticleID': articleID, 'LineID': lineID, 'flowID': flowID, 'procedureID': procedureID})
